article.story: BOCA RATON, Fla. -- — Devin Vanterpool scored 21 points as Florida Atlantic beat UTSA 110-70 on Wednesday in an American Conference opener. Vanterpool went 8 of 13 from the field (5 for 10 from 3-point range) for the Owls (9-5, 1-0). Isaiah Elohim hit two 3-pointers and scored 16, while Kanaan Carlyle sank four 3s and scored 16. Austin Nunez finished with 22 points for the Roadrunners (4-9, 0-1), who have lost six in a row. Brent Moss added 14 points, eight rebounds and four steals. Jamir Simpson had nine points. Vanterpool scored 16 to help the Owls build a 60-28 advantage at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
